title: Research sprint goal: Leftovers are recorded when made and removed only when proven finished: backlog.py own, a safe_to_remove verdict in tidy, a kbmon cleanup panel
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Open questions for this sprint (kb first, then live docs): (1) does the forge keep a merged request's source branch when the branch matches a protected pattern (code/* is protected here; request !1247 merged with force_remove_source_branch true and its branch remains; a community lead says protected branches cannot be deleted); (2) Windows: what refuses a rename or removal of a directory a process uses, and how \\?\ long paths and drive-letter case compare (os.path.normcase, realpath); (3) how a scheduled run is installed outside agent sessions: cron, launchd StartInterval, Task Scheduler (schtasks); (4) git worktree remove, prune and lock semantics (porcelain list, prunable, locked).
